args.body: At the verified invoice/CSV cutoff, reuse any committed verdict. Keep eligible requests, completed replies, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and verified settlements separate. Mark incomplete measures unknown. If the cutoff is still ahead, leave the window open. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.
